name: chat
description: Chat archiving and memorization workflows for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Chat provides workflows for synthesizing conversations into project-local archive notes and extracting durable learnings into reviewable memorize artifacts before optional Codex memory storage.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $chat:archive to synthesize a conversation range into a project-local archive note, or $chat:memorize to extract durable learnings, review them interactively, and optionally create a Codex memory update note.
